(Currently amended) Claim 1: A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at least sixteen inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 2: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced at least twenty-four inches on center.

(Currently amended) Claim 4: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and at least some of the water flows back to the water reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently amended) Claim 6: The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an outlet opening. 

(Currently amended) Claim 11: The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover that covers the housing entirely. 

(Originally presented) Claim 15: A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill.

(Currently amended) Claim 17: A cooling system, comprising: a housing for mounting within a structure wall, a cooling system configured for evaporative cooling of an indoor area. 

(Currently amended) Claim 18: The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing includes a structure flanged to attach to a pair of studs spaced at least sixteen inches on center.
